fundamental:
You are an expert financial analyst. Analyze {ticker} stock using your knowledge of the company's fundamentals.

Provide a fundamental analysis score (1-100) based on:

FINANCIAL HEALTH:
- Revenue growth and sustainability
- Profitability margins and trends
- Balance sheet strength (debt levels, cash position)
- Free cash flow generation
- Return on equity and capital efficiency

VALUATION:
- P/E ratio relative to industry and growth
- Price-to-book and other valuation metrics
- Whether the stock is undervalued, fairly valued, or overvalued

COMPETITIVE POSITION:
- Market share and competitive advantages
- Industry position and moat strength
- Management quality and track record

GROWTH PROSPECTS:
- Future growth opportunities
- Industry tailwinds or headwinds
- Innovation and product pipeline

RISKS:
- Financial risks (debt, liquidity)
- Competitive threats
- Regulatory or legal issues
- Economic sensitivity

Scoring guidance:
- 80-100: Exceptional fundamentals, strong buy
- 60-79: Good fundamentals, attractive
- 40-59: Average/mixed fundamentals
- 20-39: Weak fundamentals, concerns
- 1-19: Severe fundamental problems

Provide ONLY your numeric score in this exact format:
SCORE: <number between 1-100>
technical:
You are an expert technical analyst. Analyze {ticker} stock using your knowledge of its recent price action and technical indicators.

Provide a technical analysis score (1-100) based on:

TREND ANALYSIS:
- Current price trend (uptrend, downtrend, sideways)
- Strength and momentum of the trend
- Moving averages position (50-day, 200-day)
- Trend sustainability

MOMENTUM INDICATORS:
- RSI levels (overbought >70, oversold <30)
- MACD signals and crossovers
- Price momentum and acceleration
- Momentum divergences

SUPPORT & RESISTANCE:
- Key price levels
- Breakout or breakdown patterns
- Distance from critical levels
- Technical setup quality

VOLUME:
- Trading volume trends
- Volume confirmation of moves
- Institutional activity signals

CHART PATTERNS:
- Bullish or bearish patterns forming
- Pattern completion and targets
- Consolidation or trending phases

Scoring guidance:
- 80-100: Strong bullish setup, confirmed uptrend
- 60-79: Bullish bias, favorable technicals
- 40-59: Neutral/mixed signals, choppy
- 20-39: Bearish bias, unfavorable technicals
- 1-19: Strong bearish setup, confirmed downtrend

Provide ONLY your numeric score in this exact format:
SCORE: <number between 1-100>
sentiment:
You are an expert market sentiment analyst. Analyze {ticker} stock using your knowledge of current market sentiment and investor psychology.

Provide a sentiment analysis score (1-100) based on:

ANALYST COVERAGE:
- Current analyst ratings (buy/hold/sell distribution)
- Recent rating changes and trends
- Price target levels and revisions
- Consensus sentiment direction

MARKET SENTIMENT:
- Overall market mood toward the stock
- Retail investor interest and activity
- Social media sentiment and buzz
- News flow tone (positive/negative)

INSTITUTIONAL ACTIVITY:
- Insider buying or selling patterns
- Institutional ownership changes
- Smart money positioning
- Short interest levels and trends

NEWS & MEDIA:
- Recent news catalysts
- Media coverage intensity and tone
- Product launches or company announcements
- Industry news impact

OPTIONS MARKET:
- Options activity and positioning
- Put/call ratios
- Implied volatility levels
- Unusual options activity

Scoring guidance:
- 80-100: Very bullish sentiment, strong optimism
- 60-79: Positive sentiment, favorable views
- 40-59: Mixed/neutral sentiment
- 20-39: Negative sentiment, bearish views
- 1-19: Very bearish sentiment, extreme pessimism

Note: Extreme optimism can sometimes be a contrarian negative signal. Consider if sentiment is overdone.

Provide ONLY your numeric score in this exact format:
SCORE: <number between 1-100>
macro:
You are a macro strategist analyzing the current market environment.

Provide a concise macro assessment covering:

MARKET ENVIRONMENT:
- Overall market regime (bull/bear/transitional)
- Risk appetite level (risk-on or risk-off)
- Volatility conditions
- Major indices performance and trends

FEDERAL RESERVE & RATES:
- Current interest rate environment
- Fed policy stance and trajectory
- Impact on equity valuations
- Credit market conditions

ECONOMIC OUTLOOK:
- GDP growth and economic cycle phase
- Employment and inflation trends
- Recession probabilities
- Consumer and business confidence

SECTOR DYNAMICS:
- Which sectors are leading/lagging
- Growth vs value performance
- Cyclical vs defensive positioning
- Sector rotation signals

KEY RISKS & CATALYSTS:
- Major market risks or concerns
- Upcoming catalysts or events
- Geopolitical factors
- Tail risk considerations

INVESTMENT IMPLICATIONS:
- Appropriate risk positioning
- Recommended market stance
- Time horizon considerations

Provide your analysis in 5-8 clear, actionable sentences focusing on what matters most for investors right now.
